{"reason": "Both stockout rows (medium risk, inventory 2.8 and 5.3 days) got a late alternative supplier (195000). Alert-planner costs 35000 vs 45000 and always arrives in time, so extending the expedite branch to medium risk and raising the cutoff 5->6 makes every sub-6-day case strictly cheaper and eliminates those stockouts.", "source": "(define (expedite-response risk-level inventory-days)
  (cond
    ((and (>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium)) (< inventory-days 6))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    ((>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium))
     (list 'suggest-alternative-supplier))
    (else (list 'monitor))))"}
